svg.title: How a request flows through the pipeline
svg.desc: An English query is translated locally into 22 languages by IndicTrans2, sent over an ngrok tunnel to sarvam-m running on Colab or Kaggle for an in-language answer, translated back to English locally, assembled into a record, and checked by three validators.

g.text: In-language answer, needs a GPU this machine doesn't have
Check script/language, answer coherence, query round-trip meaning
